description: This file defines the StreamHandler class in the GuzzleHttp library responsible for handling HTTP requests using PHP's stream wrapper. It manages request sending, response creation, stream management, headers processing, proxy handling, and related networking tasks within Guzzle's HTTP client implementation.

classes.name: GuzzleHttp\Handler\StreamHandler
classes.description: Implements an HTTP handler that makes requests using PHP's stream wrapper, supporting request execution, response creation, and stream management, primarily used internally by GuzzleHttp client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the sending of an HTTP request using PHP streams, including delay, protocol support validation, stream creation, and exception handling for network errors.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the 'on_stats' callback with transfer statistics if provided in options.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Constructs a Guzzle PSR7 Response object from raw headers, stream, and other parameters, managing headers decoding and calling relevant callbacks.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a sink stream for response content, supporting optional streaming or sink callback.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Decodes the response stream content if encoding is gzip or deflate, adjusting headers accordingly.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains data from the source stream into the sink stream, respecting the content length if specified.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a resource using a callback, with error handling for resource creation failures.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource based on the request, options, and context, ensuring proper setup for request execution.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves host IPs if specified in options, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 resolution via DNS lookups.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Builds default stream context options from the request, including headers, method, SSL options, and body content.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Adds proxy settings to the request based on provided options.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses a proxy URL into components suitable for stream context configuration.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Adds a timeout setting to the request options.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Adds SSL crypto method options based on the request parameter.

methods.name: add_verify
methods.description: Configures SSL verification options, including CA bundle verification.

methods.name: add_cert
methods.description: Sets local SSL certificate options.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Sets up progress notification callback during the stream transfer.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Sets debug callback for stream events, logging various stream notifications.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Wraps and adds a notification callback into the stream transfer parameters.

methods.name: callArray
methods.description: Combines multiple callback functions into a single callable that invokes them sequentially.
